prompt:
Generate a transparent-background pixel-art atlas exactly TWO square cells side-by-side, TOP then BOTTOM, for the exact Iron Tracks signal mast in the source. Native source and accepted FRONT/RIGHT/LEFT/REAR in the attached labeled contact control identity and relative offsets. Principal views must be genuinely horizontal plan projections: TOP camera directly above from +Z; BOTTOM directly below from -Z. This object is physically a tall mast, but these two views show only XY footprints, NEVER its tall vertical silhouette. Use explicit plan axes: X is screen left-to-right in the plan; Y is depth; Z is vertical. Final full object X span in TOP/BOTTOM should be about 118px at 256 canvas, matching the FRONT full width; keep depth under 90px.

TOP, looking straight down: the red upper horizontal signal barrel is the highest Z and occludes the lower green light at exactly the same XY, so draw ONLY ONE compact dark-gray rounded barrel-roof footprint on the LEFT side of the footprint, with a tiny red lens rim on its forward Y edge. Do NOT show two lamps, stacked signal cylinders, vertical pole shaft, full ladder/rungs, or frontal lamp faces. To its RIGHT draw one small round pole-cap footprint, then farther RIGHT only two compact ladder rail-end/footprints (not the full upright ladder). Keep these three footprints laid out horizontally across X: lamp on left, pole near center, ladder on right.

BOTTOM, looking straight up: lower green lamp is lowest Z and similarly occludes red lamp; draw only ONE compact dark rounded lamp-underside footprint on the LEFT, one small pole/baseplate footprint beneath the pole near center-right, and two small ladder-foot/end footprints farther right. No stacked pair of lamps and no vertical pole or ladder view. Keep both cells on the same X/Y orientation and 118px full width, shallow plan depth.

Use only source materials/colors (dark steel, tiny signal red/green edge, gray baseplate). Isolated object footprints, transparent background, no labels, perspective, shadows, stray guides, clipped pixels, or full upright silhouettes. Crisp pixel-art clusters.
